title: IT IS TIME TO DEVELOP AN AUDITING FRAMEWORK TO PROMOTE VALUE AWARE CHATBOTS
benchmark_measurement: The paper's proposed benchmark framework did not measure faith/religion. It only cited a separate study that measured anti-Muslim bias as an example of known biases in LLMs.
findings: This paper did not produce its own findings on religion. It cited a previous study by Abid et al. (2021) which found persistent anti-Muslim bias in large language models.
